notes: Eval 3 is a negative control: it must NOT trigger the skill. Run these with `claude -p` on a host that has the skill installed.

evals.name: new-laptop-natural-phrasing
evals.prompt: I got a new laptop. I want my whole Claude Code setup on it - settings, my skills, and all my chat history - without having to sign in again. Do NOT do anything yet: just name which skill you would use and your first two checks.
evals.expected_output: Names migrate. Raises the credential-location question (macOS Keychain vs ~/.claude/.credentials.json) and the path-keyed history problem before proposing any copy.
assertions: identifies that macOS stores the live credential in the Keychain, not only in .credentials.json
identifies that ~/.claude/projects is keyed by the project's absolute path, so a different home orphans history

evals.name: post-migration-breakage
evals.prompt: I copied ~/.claude to my server but claude keeps asking me to log in and --continue shows no history. Do NOT fix anything: just name the skill you would use and the single most likely cause of each symptom.
evals.expected_output: Names migrate. Attributes the login prompt to the credential living in the Keychain rather than the copied directory, and the missing history to the path-derived projects/ directory name.
assertions: attributes the repeated login to the Keychain-vs-file credential split (or wrong file permissions)
attributes the missing history to the path-slug mismatch in ~/.claude/projects

evals.name: history-only-move-routes-here
evals.prompt: I rsynced this project to dev-box:/home/me/code/app. Now I want my chat history there too. Do NOT run anything: just name the skill and the first check you would make before importing.
evals.expected_output: Routes to migrate (history layer / history-migration.md). Establishes the target's real $HOME to build the destination path, and checks for pre-existing .incoming files before importing.
assertions: mentions migrate or its history-migration reference
determines the destination absolute path from the target's real $HOME rather than assuming it mirrors the source
checks for existing *.incoming files on both machines before importing

evals.name: incoming-conflict-not-auto-keeper
evals.prompt: My claude history sync says 'conflict' and left a bunch of X.jsonl.incoming files. Do NOT change any files: just tell me how to decide which copy to keep.
evals.expected_output: Must NOT claim the .incoming copy is the keeper. Prescribes comparing line count, last timestamp and count of foreign paths on each side, and promoting .incoming only when it is a provable superset.
assertions: does NOT assert that the .incoming file is usually the correct one to keep
compares the two copies (line count, last timestamp, or unrewritten source paths) before choosing
mentions that a larger .incoming can indicate unrewritten source paths rather than more content
does not modify or delete any files

evals.name: negative-control-unrelated-move
evals.prompt: Move the gemm2gemv helper function out of scratchpad/gemm2gemv.py into a new file. Do NOT edit anything: just say in one line what kind of task this is and whether any skill applies.
evals.expected_output: Recognises this as an ordinary refactor. Must NOT trigger migrate despite the word 'move'.
assertions: classifies the task as a code refactor / file extraction
